description.en-US: Aquinas's commentary on Aristotle's *Metaphysics* — on being qua being, substance, the categories, the first principles of all things, and the unmoved mover.
description.la: Expositio *Metaphysicorum* Aristotelis — de ente in quantum ens, de substantia, de categoriis, de primis principiis omnium rerum, de primo motore.
description.pt-BR: Comentário de Santo Tomás de Aquino à *Metafísica* de Aristóteles — sobre o ente enquanto ente, a substância, as categorias, os primeiros princípios de todas as coisas e o motor imóvel.

sources.description: English translation by John P. Rowan (Henry Regnery, Chicago, 1961), revised by the Aquinas Institute. Mirrored from aquinas.cc.
Latin text from the Leonine / Marietti editions (public domain), mirrored from aquinas.cc.
